turns.replyText:
Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
It really comes down to your spice collection and cabinet space!
The cheaper option ($81.00 USD for the 22xADJx11 DIY) is completely fine and fantastic if you mostly use standard-sized spice jars. It gives you all the heavy-duty features, ball-bearing slides, and flexible bands in a compact 4.6" width.
The slightly pricier 33xADJx11 model is worth the extra cost if you have larger, wider spice bottles or bulk containers, as its 6.9" width gives you that extra room so everything fits without crowding.
